answer_1.quote: ...In zero-shot extractive summarization, we train an extractive model (based on a pre-trained multilingual transformer) on English summarization dataset, which selects important sentences in English documents. Then, we apply this trained model to documents of a different language (i.e., extracting sentences of documents in another language)...

answer_2.quote: ...We report the F1 ROUGE-L score of NLSSum with a full Python implemented ROUGE metric, which calculates the overlap lexical units between extracted sentences and ground-truth... Table 3: ROUGE-L on MLSUM dataset...

answer_4.quote: ...The human evaluation is important for summarization tasks... we design the ranking experiment with system outputs of different systems on the German test set of MLSUM... Participants are requested to rank these summaries by taking the importance and redundancy into account...
